meta.description: Convert Acre (ac) to Hectare (ha) instantly. 1 ac = 0.40468564 ha. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert acres (ac) to hectares (ha) instantly. Both measure area, so the relationship is strictly linear: each acre equals 0.40468564 hectares. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One acre is equal to **0.40468564 hectares**. To go the other way, one hectare equals **2.4710538 acres**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> hectares = acres × 0.40468564

Worked example — converting 10 acres:

10 × 0.40468564 = **4.0468564 ha**.

To invert, divide by 0.40468564 (or multiply by 2.4710538).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 ac ≈ 0.40468564 ha. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Acre and Hectare both measure area; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
